name: higgsfield
description: High-fidelity AI video generation and Director of Photography (DoP) camera controls. Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, camera pathing (pan, tilt, zoom, dolly, roll, orbit), character avatars, lip-sync, and 4K upscaling.

capabilities.description: Generate cinematic video from text prompt with customizable DoP camera controls (motion, angles, speed, aspect ratio).
Animate a still image into dynamic video using prompt guidance and camera vectors.
Apply precise Director of Photography (DoP) camera trajectories to an existing prompt or scene.
Synthesize a consistent character persona or actor for multi-shot video production.
Synchronize character lips and facial performance with an audio speech track.
Enhance resolution up to 4K and perform frame interpolation up to 60fps.
Transfer human motion or camera movement from a reference video onto a target character.
Query live generation task progress, rendering stage, and output URL.
Cancel an in-progress video rendering task.
Download completed MP4 video asset to local disk with SHA-256 hash validation.
List historical video generations with status and metadata.
Permanently delete a video generation asset from Higgsfield storage.
Dispatch raw HTTP request to Higgsfield AI API endpoint.
